boundary.description: From the railway bridge on River Irwell near MOSI, S then W by River Irwell and Manchester Ship Canal to the point opposite the footpath near SIS Live Teleport (Media City UK), then by a bee-line NE to and E along Broadway, to the point opposite Olympic Court. By a bee-line N to and along Olympic Court, Montford Street, West Ashton Street, Eccles New Road, to the point opposite Cyprus Close. By a bee-line N to and E along the railway to the railway bridge on River Irwell.
